dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: "It has now been determined that the cause of the water pollution, tragically, was a young female taking her own life at the water source. The Millelith would like to extend their sincere condolences to the victim's family."

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: "Out of respect for the privacy of the victim and her family, we will not publish her name."
